title: Experience Mind-Blowing Magic Up Close in Orlando
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Every performance is intimate, immersive, and interactive. You’re not watching from the back of a theater—you’re in the heart of the action. Guests are often invited onstage, helping create illusions that feel personal and unforgettable. Every trick, every laugh, every jaw-dropping moment happens right in front of you.

At The Magic Studio, the performers are nationally touring master magicians, handpicked for their ability to astonish and entertain. The magic is unpredictable, fresh, and expertly crafted, so no two shows are ever the same.

Whether it’s sleight-of-hand up close, impossible predictions, or illusions that defy reality, a ticket here promises an experience that is thrilling, intimate, and utterly unlike any other Orlando attraction. It’s not just a show—it’s a night where reality bends, and you get to be part of the wonder.
